title: Reference-time layouts
hints: Go layouts are written using one specific moment, Mon Jan 2 15:04:05 MST 2006, not letters like YYYY. "YYYY" is copied out literally.
A date is "2006-01-02". The layout passed to Parse has to match the input's shape exactly, and the input here has no time of day.
For a 12-hour clock without a leading zero use "3:04 PM". 15 means the 24-hour clock.
